method.ttft_definition: Client elapsed seconds until first token-bearing SSE event.
method.intertoken_definition: Each inter-event gap divided over tokens in its arriving event; client delivery estimate only.
method.spec_acceptance_definition: Delta accepted draft tokens / delta proposed draft tokens.
method.mean_acceptance_length_definition: 1 + delta accepted draft tokens / delta draft steps; convention includes one bonus token per draft step.
method.server_histogram_definition: Mean engine output event interval; not actual individual token latency under MTP.

caveats: Small screening experiment: four measured requests per concurrency per arm (two per workload), one old-release arm and one MTP1 arm. No confidence interval or reliable tail-latency claim.
A2 reversed concurrency order (2 then 1); A, B, C used 1 then 2. Candidate median decode TPS increased 4.6–4.9% between A and A2; order, warm state and other drift were not isolated.
Matched prompts and fixed 192-token limits do not force identical output sequences. Seven of eight A/C and eight of eight A2/C pairs differ; prompt token IDs and request bodies match.

Only short text prompts (73 and 133 tokens), temperature zero and thinking disabled. This screen does not characterize image inference, long-context prefill/decode, natural stopping, reasoning quality or saturation throughput.

The old package was run in the current environment with the same explicit pinned OpenCL ICD used by the new wrapper. This is a current-environment comparison, not reconstruction of the original failing host service.
Streaming delivers speculative bursts. Normalized inter-token values are delivery estimates; the server inter_token_latency histogram counts engine output events, not individual token compute times.
All reported performance gains compare complete package stacks. The applicable upstream Qwen fusion is supported by source inspection, but its individual contribution was not isolated.
Artifacts referenced under benchmark-results are local ignored evidence. Public JSON preserves per-request metrics, token hashes and SHA-256 hashes, not raw generated text or SSE streams.
